patterns.note: Full-width sections with centered, often oversized content, creating a strong vertical rhythm and visual impact.
Extreme typographic hierarchy with massive, condensed, uppercase sans-serif headings dominating the page, contrasting with smaller, simple sans-serif body text and labels.
A stark, high-contrast palette primarily consisting of black backgrounds and white or light gray text, punctuated by occasional strong accent colors like deep blue and bright red.
A sticky header system where the 'NEW TOUR ANNOUNCEMENT' and 'PERTURBATOR' titles remain fixed at the top of the viewport, while the hero image and subsequent page content scroll *underneath* them.
A persistent footer navigation bar that remains visible at the bottom of the viewport even as the main page content scrolls completely out of view.

technique_notes: The site employs a layered sticky header where key branding elements and a top announcement bar are fixed to the viewport, allowing subsequent content, including a large hero image, to scroll beneath them, creating a dynamic reveal effect. This likely uses CSS positioning and z-index.
A persistent footer navigation is fixed to the bottom of the viewport, ensuring access to main site links regardless of scroll position.
Content sections are primarily full-width, using large, bold typography and stark color contrasts to establish visual hierarchy and impact, often with generous vertical spacing between blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed, uppercase headings (up to ~8x body) create a dominant, aggressive character, with smaller uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and main title areas, transitioning to a balanced density in content and list sections.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its unapologetically brutalist aesthetic, leveraging extreme typographic scale and a stark black-and-white palette to create a powerful, almost confrontational user experience. The unique sticky header, where the main title reveals itself as content scrolls underneath, adds a dynamic and memorable interaction that elevates it beyond a standard band page.
